en: Haya - Your Highness, are you awake?
Raymond - Oh, the prince is awake.
Kevin - That man over there saved us.
Crow - If you're awake, let's get out of here. There are still Imperial troops nearby, so be careful.
Raymond - But the prince has only just woken up...
Crow - Hmph. They say the house of Pandragon has bred great warriors for generations. Just a rumour, it seems. Making such a fuss over a little scratch.
Raymond - What?! How dare you insult the house of Pandragon!
Crow - Is there anything left of the house of Pandragon to insult? All that's left is that naive little prince.
Rashid - It's all right, Raymond. I can stand on my own. And sir knight, thank you for saving our lives, but I'd be grateful if you didn't judge my whole house by me alone.

Crow - Hmph. Finally you talk like a prince of Pandragon. I'm Crow, a wandering knight. Since it seems we'll be together for a while, let me say this: I won't go easy on you just because you're a prince, so watch yourself!
